title: [seam -> repo:objectui] Re-seed / Purge throw the error CODE away — `readApiError(payload, res).message` renders the withheld 5xx constant while `ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE` arrives unread
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud` execution PM seat (seat post objectstack#6026), session `session_01TAUTP6Yky8QWoHUAPDKNJQ`, at 2026-09-16T08:42Z, as the **consumer half** of cloud#2072. ⛔ Not graded or routed beyond the lane label — that is the objectui seat's.

⚠️ Filed in this repo rather than in `objectstack-ai/objectui` because that repository is not reachable to this session's credential; this is the established seam carrier for that case (objectstack#18377, objectstack#18387 are the same shape).

## The gap, measured

cloud#2072 was ruled by the maintainer (director batch #79, 2026-09-08, verbatim 「其他同意」): re-seed / purge on a control plane that holds no environment kernels must earn a real error **code** — `ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE` — while the HTTP **status stays 500**, because 「the code is the one thing that crosses the cloud#1145 5xx sentence-withholding, so the Console can render a true sentence without any client seeing a different status」.

**The producer half lands in cloud PR #2303. The consumer half throws the code away**, measured at `.objectui-sha` `efead6c6` by the cloud#2072 dev and reported rather than inferred:

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/marketplaceApi.ts:571` (`reseedSampleData`) and `:592` (`purgeSampleData`) return **`readApiError(payload, res).message`**.
- ⇒ The `code` member never reaches the caller. The refusal still renders the withheld generic 5xx sentence, exactly as it did before cloud#2072.

⇒ **The whole user-visible payoff of that ruling is blocked here.** The control plane now says *which* fault occurred; the Console still says nothing.

## Why it matters more than one string

The two faults are not interchangeable, and the difference is what the user should do next:

| fault | what it means | the right next step |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE` | this control plane registers **no `kernel-manager`** — a composition fact | ⛔ **never retry**; go to the environment's own runtime |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | the environment kernel or its engine could not be reached **right now** | a retry may well work |

⇒ A Console that collapses both into one sentence sends a user to retry a button that **cannot ever** succeed on that deployment. cloud#2303's docs page says so in as many words: 「a client that sees `ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE` should say so and stop offering the retry」.

## ⚠️ And the buttons ARE reachable on that deployment — measured, narrowly

The same round discharged the ruling's carried question 「nobody measured whether the Console even renders the reseed / purge buttons on a kernel-manager-less composition」. Reading at `.objectui-sha` `efead6c6`:

- `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:762` renders the menu when `!localInstall && cloudInstall && !getRuntimeConfig().cloudUrl`.
- `createCloudStack` serves `cloudUrl: ''` with `installLocal: false` (cloud `cloud-stack.ts:354-359`), so conjuncts 1 and 3 hold **on the control plane**; the hidden case is the TENANT runtime.
- `cloudInstall` is `null` on page load (no `defaultEnvironmentId` is sent, so `getCloudInstallationInfo` takes its empty-id early return) but **is set by the post-install refresh** at `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx:313-321`.

⇒ An org admin who just installed an app **is** offered Re-seed / Purge, in that session, on the one deployment where they cannot work. This is not a hypothetical surface.

## What this card asks

Surface the code on those two calls so the Console can branch on it, and render the composition fact as a terminal refusal rather than a retryable error. ⛔ Do not change the status handling and ⛔ do not invent copy for codes that do not arrive — read `error.code` and branch; the two sentences are already written in cloud `docs/design/installation-action-refusals.md`.

⚠️ Check `readApiError`'s other callers before changing its shape: if it drops `code` for every consumer, this is a wider fix than two lines and the objectui seat should scope it that way.

## Provenance

cloud#2072 (the ruling) · cloud PR #2303 (the producer half) · cloud#2043 (the stop-and-report fork this came from) · cloud#1145 (the 5xx sentence-withholding that makes `code` the only channel).

## 查重词

`marketplaceApi readApiError code` · `reseedSampleData purgeSampleData error code` · `ENVIRONMENT_KERNEL_UNAVAILABLE console` · `withheld 5xx sentence console` · `re-seed purge terminal refusal`
